# MIDDAY BRIEF – Bitcoin's Anti-Fragility Test

**The macro picture: regulatory skepticism is backfiring.** Bitcoin holding $75,910 on +1.5% as traditional finance implodes—that's not coincidence. Hashrate surged to 1065 EH/s, proving the network strengthens when attacked, not weakens.

**On-chain reality check:** Fear & Greed at 29 shows sentiment crushed, yet mempool stays active at 65K transactions. This disconnect is the signal—fear suppresses price, not conviction. Fastest fees at 2 sat/vB
